title: Native Android recorder finalisation
details: Removes the second MediaRecorder proxy so Video Observation has one recorder finalisation layer
Uses Android Chrome's native MediaRecorder.stop() lifecycle first instead of stopping camera and microphone tracks before recorder finalisation
Keeps one-second Android recording chunks and allows a final requestData flush before stop
Uses track shutdown only as an emergency fallback if native stop does not complete within the hard timeout
Keeps bounded private media storage and existing learner data, observations, reviews, QR, evidence and document formats unchanged
